packageRules.description: Major updates: one PR per package (API breaks reviewed individually). groupName: null overrides any inherited monorepo group from config:recommended's group:monorepos / group:recommended presets. Applies to the customManagers workflow-annotation manager as well — by design; the customManagers block has no groupName, so this just reasserts the default.

Rust compiler: its own reviewable PR, never automerged. A compiler bump lands new default-on clippy lints across the whole crate at once, so it must not ride in a batch (see rust-toolchain.toml). groupName: null un-groups it; automerge: false overrides the major-updates rule above, which matches every manager including this one. Last rule wins — this rule must stay LAST in this array.
